records.scope: First scoped review of an existing legacy vessel or station: original short description, all twelve inherited fields assessed, explicit individual/type/station boundaries and selected work/context links. Numeric ID, title, slug and origin retained.
limitations: This dossier follows the Phantom Menace J-type 327 vessel. Other legacy Naboo diplomatic barges, yachts and star skiffs retain their own records; no later appearance or manufacturer is assigned simply because another silver Naboo craft looks related.

The inherited model and 76 m dimension are established. The source does not certify the yacht class label or combined Theed/Nubia manufacturer string. Offensive weapons are explicitly absent, but shields and a hyperdrive are explicitly present.

T-14 is the replacement generator designation, not a hyperdrive class. No price, atmospheric speed, crew/passenger capacity, cargo mass, consumables, numerical rating 1.8 or MGLT established. Ric’s named piloting and Padmé’s carriage do not establish eight crew or certify another linked person’s statistics.

Only the stated details and selected connections are checked. Raw unestablished values and source IDs remain in the audit but are withheld from current published facts and collection previews. Other legacy relationships remain pending.
No new records, episode rows, credits, dates or editions. Original-US release research scope retained. A public reference is not an open text or media licence.
